verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gusto offers MCP servers (a Dev Assistant MCP for API/docs, and a remote MCP server for account data) that let external AI tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor connect to Gusto — this is external-assistant connectivity, not a built-in AI assistant embedded within the Gusto product itself for end-users to delegate payroll/HR tasks to. No evidence of a native in-app AI assistant/chatbot inside Gusto's UI.
